title: Better Ghast Harness PROGRAMMER ART
description: The Programmer Art version of my Better Ghast Harness for those who want compatibility.
body:
**THIS RESOURCE PACK IS NOT TO BE REUPLOADED BY ITSELF ANYWHERE BY ANYONE EXCEPT MidniteDemolisher.**

---

**This resource pack may be included in modpacks to be distributed! Please do not remove my credit.**

---

I made this for myself, but I figured if I uploaded the current texture version, I may as well share the Programmer Art version too XD This pack is the same as my Better Ghast Harness, but in the style of Programmer Art!

### **WHAT TO EXPECT:**
- Happy ghasts match the PA ghasts
- The ghastlings were retextured into PA style
- All colors of the harness were done
- The harness is my overhaul of it, not Mojang's vanilla harness
- The blue ghastling is in this pack too!

**Don't want Programmer Art? Don't like the goggles? Want more options? Default and the updated texture versions with goggles can be found on my Modrinth page, and versions without the goggles can be found on my [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/midnitedemolisher/projects)! Modrinth doesn't allow multiple different files under one project, and I would have 9 different projects if I uploaded all the versions here, which is too much for one single thing for me XD**

**Remember to place the pack ABOVE the Default (or Programmer Art) packs. It will warn you that the pack was made for a newer version, but it will work!**
![Image showing the pack order, with Better Ghast Harness activated above Programmer Art and Default.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bbfc2ff763a41a29544720c5fb6a65fa8804f08.png)
